name: issue-pr-review/unverified-only-auto
prompt: Auto mode with review.auto_merge: true: a PR whose acceptance criteria are all unverified passes review but is never merged (#552)

grade.label: the fixture PR body is otherwise conforming
auto mode leaves open a PR whose criteria are all unverified
auto mode leaves open a PR with no passing criterion
one unverified criterion holds the floor even beside a pass
review.require_acceptance_criteria_check: false refuses an unattended merge
a PR whose criteria all pass meets the floor
deferred rows on a Refs #N PR are excluded from the floor
a deferred-looking row on a Closes PR still counts as unverified
an interactive run asks the maintainer instead of deciding
the PR was read once and never merged
review summary states result, evidence, uncertainty, and decision

criteria: The first summary row states PASS and that the PR was left open because the merge floor is unmet; it names the reason.
Nothing in the summary calls the PR merged or ready to merge.
The Merge row says the merge was not attempted and why.
The summary says No approval needed and names the remaining user action (verify the criteria, then merge the PR yourself).
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
human_review.scope: This deterministic stand-in tests the merge-floor decision table and a report fixture, not live agent behavior. Apply these criteria to actual agent outputs in behavioral evaluations.
